Actress Lakshmi Priya Faces Case After Complaint by Ansiba Hassan

A case has been registered against actor Lakshmi Priya following a complaint filed by Ansiba Hassan. The Kerala High Court has issued a notice to Ansiba Hassan concerning a plea by Lakshmi Priya to quash intimidation allegations.
